title: From One to Many: Expanding the Scope of Toxicity Mitigation in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of toxicity mitigation, which involves reducing harmful, offensive, or harassing text in large language models across multiple languages. While it addresses 'harms' and utilizes the HolisticBias dataset which contains demographic axes like religion and culture, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or complex ethical/moral reasoning frameworks.
